name: Helium
tagline: A Chromium-based web browser made for people, with love. Privacy-first with unbiased ad-blocking.
description: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser made for people, with love. Privacy-first with unbiased ad-blocking.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/helium:0.20.1@sha256:e1485c3408f3d41c0169eaf7f61762b238f466b64682fd5a9c071b477ccd6680
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      HELIUM_CLI: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
